metadata.title: Alternative proof of the gradient estimate for complex Hessian equations
metadata.abstract: For complex Hessian equations on compact Kähler manifolds, we give an alternative proof of the gradient estimate without using blow-up argument, and clarify its dependence on the right-hand side. In addition, using the similar approach, the case of Kähler manifolds with boundary is also investigated.
